title: Xcode adapter generates a macOS project from canonical Pkl resources
persona: assistant generating a macOS application project through Vaporize
steps: The assistant selects the Xcode authority and a project.pkl that amends the canonical XcodeProjectDefinition module.
Vaporize evaluates the complete Xcode project definition, including existing Xcode-specific sources and portable target resources.
The Xcode adapter preserves sources, settings, dependencies, schemes, build phases, and release identity.
Portable copy resources are projected into the selected target's PBX Resources phase.
Vaporize writes a valid .xcodeproj and records the generated project and resource mapping without invoking WCode or PowerShell.
evidenceScope: The listed tests prove Pkl evaluation and generated PBX world state. Native xcodebuild validation remains pending in the macOS release lane, and mixed-platform target selection remains tracked by the canonical wrkstrm-core bug bead.
failureJourneys: A portable process resource has no admitted Xcode processor.
A required resource path is missing.
Adding portable resources changes an existing sources[].buildPhase projection.
